name: editor
one_liner: A browser-based 3D room and building designer, like a lightweight, free version of professional architecture software, that runs in your web browser with no install.
buyer: An interior designer or small architecture firm who currently pays for expensive CAD/BIM software licenses and wants a fast, shareable way to mock up room layouts for clients.
business_use_cases: A furniture retailer embeds it on their website so customers can drag their actual furniture SKUs into a 3D floor plan before buying.
An interior design freelancer uses it to produce quick, shareable 3D concepts for clients instead of static mood boards, closing deals faster.
A real estate agency creates 3D staging previews of empty listings to help buyers visualize furnished spaces.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche 'room planner' SaaS on top of it for a specific vertical like kitchen remodeling or home staging, charging per project.
Offer a white-labeled embed for furniture and home-goods e-commerce sites, billed monthly per site.

steal_this: Fork it into a single-purpose 'kitchen layout planner' for a local cabinet or furniture shop and sell it to them as a $500 lead-generation tool for their website this weekend.
